description: States that are below the first administrative level. Upstream lists some lower levels (boroughs, departments, provinces, districts) alongside the first-level regions; generate-world.ps1 sets State.IsTopLevel = false for every state of a country whose type is in lowerLevelTypes or whose code is in lowerLevelCodes. The lower-level type differs per country: "province" is the top level in Canada and China, so types are listed per country.

FR.note: Paris (75C) and the Métropole de Lyon (69M) are typed like Corsica, and Alsace (6AE) is now part of Grand Est.

IE.note: The counties are the first level; the four provinces have no administrative role.

LT.note: The ten counties are the first level. Several municipalities share their county's name (Vilnius, Kaunas, Šiauliai…).
